Quick review · real situations
☀️Real · it can happen
If+ present simple,will+ verb
☀️A real, likely situation in the future.
➡️We say what we expect to happen next.
Ifwe find clean water,we willdrink it.
Ifit rains heavily,we willstay in the shelter.

The rule

Iwould+ verbbecause …

💬Because = my reason.

If+ past simple,would+ verb
